name: OMathScrSubSup
description: Represents an equation with a base that contains a superscript or subscript.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathScrSubSup object.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

properties.name: Sub
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the subscript for a subscript-superscript object. Read-only.

properties.name: Sup
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the superscript for a subscript-superscript object. Read-only.

properties.name: AlignScripts
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to horizontally align subscripts and superscripts in the sub-superscript object. Read/write.

methods.name: RemoveSub
methods.description: Removes the subscript for an equation and returns an OMathFunction object that represents the updated equation without the subscript.

methods.name: RemoveSup
methods.description: Removes the superscript for an equation and returns an OMathFunction object that represents the updated equation without the superscript.

methods.name: ToScrPre
methods.description: Converts an equation with a base superscript or subscript to an equation with a superscript or subscript to the left of the base.
